study_identification_part.si_4_title: A normative modelling approach reveals age-atypical cortical thickness in a subgroup of males with autism spectrum disorder

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study leveraged the ABIDE I and ABIDE II datasets, pooling them to achieve greater statistical power.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: To achieve this, we utilized the ABIDE datasets (ABIDE I and II; 15).

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Typically developing (TD) males from both datasets were used to estimate population norms (normative modelling). Individuals with an autism diagnosis (ASD) were then compared against these norms to compute individualized w-scores (clinical analysis).
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: Normative modelling of age-related CT effects was done utilizing male-only data from the typically developing group (TD) ... These statistical norms were then used to compute a w-score (analogous to a z-score) for every individual with autism

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The initial matched sample included 660 typically developing (TD) males. For the final normative modelling, age bins with fewer than five data-points were excluded, leaving a final normative reference sample of 624 TD males.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: After matching case and control groups ... we were left with a sample size N = 870 per group (Tables 2 and 3) [Table 2 shows Male TD N=660] ... Age bins that contained fewer than five data-points in the TD group were excluded from subsequent analysis ... The characteristics of the final autism sample are listed in Table 1 [Table 1 shows TD N=624]

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Overall-phase statistics correspond to the initial matched TD male sample (N=660). Train-phase statistics correspond to the final sample used for normative reference after excluding small age bins (N=624). Values were obtained from Table 2 and Table 1 respectively.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: Table 2 Sample characteristics of age [TD Male: Mean 16.64, SD 8.98, Median 13.69, Min 5.89, Max 64] ... Table 1 Sample age characteristics after normative modelling selection [TD: Mean 15.35, SD 6.37, Median 13.34, Min 5.89, Max 39.4]

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Due to the limited number of female participants and known sex differences in developmental trajectories, normative modelling was performed exclusively on the male group.
dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: Given the reduced sample size in the female group and the known interaction between autism and biological sex ... as well as the known sex differences in developmental trajectories ... we conducted normative modelling on the male group only
